description: Singapore resident household income from work. Returns the median monthly household income (or, with `indicator`, a chosen series such as average income, a specific decile, or the Gini coefficient). Annual, from DOS via SingStat (M810871).

indicator.description: Series to return (substring match). Examples: 'Median Monthly Household Market Income', 'Average Monthly Household Market Income Per Household Member', 'Gini'. Default = median income.

name: sg_household_income
